meta.title: SANHA — China Sourcing, Payment, CNY Exchange & Shipping
meta.description: One-stop China import service: product sourcing, purchasing, supplier payment, CNY exchange, and truck or sea freight delivered to your door in Thailand.

home.heroTitle: Import from China, all in one place
home.heroSubtitle: Sourcing, purchasing, supplier payment, CNY exchange and door-to-door delivery — we handle every step.
home.trackLink: Have a tracking number? Track it here →
home.methodsSubtitle: From our China warehouse to Thailand, by truck or by sea

methods.title: Truck freight
methods.body: Overland via Laos or Vietnam. Fast — ideal for goods you want to sell quickly or smaller items.

methods.title: Sea freight
methods.body: More economical — ideal for bulky or heavy goods and larger volumes.

home.ctaBody: Send us product links or details and our team will advise you.

steps.title: Send your list
steps.body: Share 1688 / Taobao links or photos of what you need

steps.title: Get a quote
steps.body: We find suppliers, check prices and send you a total

steps.title: Pay in THB
steps.body: You pay in baht, we pay the Chinese supplier in yuan

steps.title: Delivered to you
steps.body: Consolidated at our China warehouse, shipped by truck or sea to your address

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: We handle every step, from finding products in China to delivering them to you.

items.title: Product sourcing
items.body: We find the right factories and shops, compare prices and check quality before ordering.

items.title: Purchasing agent
items.body: We order from 1688, Taobao, Tmall and Chinese suppliers, and negotiate for you.

items.title: Supplier payment & CNY
items.body: Transfer baht and we pay your Chinese shop or supplier in yuan.

items.title: Truck / sea freight
items.body: Choose by speed and budget, charged by weight or volume.

items.title: Customs clearance
items.body: We handle import formalities so you don't have to.

items.title: Door-to-door
items.body: Domestic delivery to your address anywhere in Thailand.

calculator.excludes: Excludes domestic delivery, wooden crating and cargo insurance.
